Elements hidden via inline style="display:none" must not appear in the output

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p>visible</p><div style="display:none">secret hidden text</div><p>also visible</p>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone()));
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
